description.sr:
Napiši dve funkcije, `pipe(...fns)` i `compose(...fns)`, koje spajaju više funkcija u jednu.

Obe vraćaju novu funkciju. `pipe` primenjuje funkcije redom sleva nadesno: rezultat jedne postaje ulaz sledeće. `compose` radi isto zdesna nalevo, kao u matematici: `compose(f, g)(x)` je `f(g(x))`.

Pravila:
- funkcija koja se izvršava prva (prva kod `pipe`, poslednja kod `compose`) može da primi više argumenata; sve ostale primaju tačno jedan, rezultat prethodne
- bez ijedne funkcije vraćena funkcija vraća svoj prvi argument nepromenjen

Primeri:
```
const add1 = (x) => x + 1;
const double = (x) => x * 2;
const sum = (a, b) => a + b;

pipe(add1, double)(3);    // 8, jer (3 + 1) * 2
compose(add1, double)(3); // 7, jer (3 * 2) + 1
pipe(sum, double)(2, 3);  // 10, sum prima oba argumenta
pipe()(5);                // 5
```
description.en:
Write two functions, `pipe(...fns)` and `compose(...fns)`, that join several functions into one.

Both return a new function. `pipe` applies the functions from left to right: the result of one becomes the input of the next. `compose` does the same from right to left, as in mathematics: `compose(f, g)(x)` is `f(g(x))`.

Rules:
- the function that runs first (the first one for `pipe`, the last one for `compose`) can receive several arguments; all the others receive exactly one, the result of the previous one
- with no functions at all the returned function returns its first argument unchanged

Examples:
```
const add1 = (x) => x + 1;
const double = (x) => x * 2;
const sum = (a, b) => a + b;

pipe(add1, double)(3);    // 8, because (3 + 1) * 2
compose(add1, double)(3); // 7, because (3 * 2) + 1
pipe(sum, double)(2, 3);  // 10, sum receives both arguments
pipe()(5);                // 5
```

text.sr: `pipe` skuplja funkcije u niz `fns` i vraća funkciju koja skuplja argumente u `args`. Ako nema nijedne funkcije, vraća prvi argument nepromenjen (`args[0]`).
text.en: `pipe` collects the functions into the array `fns` and returns a function that collects the arguments into `args`. If there are no functions it returns the first argument unchanged (`args[0]`).

text.sr:
Destrukturiranje `[first, ...rest]` odvaja prvu funkciju od ostalih. Prva dobija sve argumente (`first(...args)`), a taj rezultat je početna vrednost za `reduce`. `reduce` zatim prolazi kroz preostale funkcije i svaku primenjuje na prethodni rezultat. Ako je `rest` prazan niz, `reduce` sa početnom vrednošću vraća baš tu vrednost, pa jedna funkcija radi bez posebnog slučaja.

```
pipe(add1, double)(3):
first = add1, rest = [double]
start = add1(3) = 4
double(4) = 8
```
text.en:
The destructuring `[first, ...rest]` separates the first function from the others. The first one receives all the arguments (`first(...args)`), and that result is the starting value for `reduce`. `reduce` then goes through the remaining functions and applies each to the previous result. If `rest` is an empty array, `reduce` with a starting value returns exactly that value, so a single function works without a special case.

```
pipe(add1, double)(3):
first = add1, rest = [double]
start = add1(3) = 4
double(4) = 8
```
The returned function and `pipe` are closed.

text.sr: `compose` je `pipe` sa obrnutim redosledom: `compose(f, g)(x)` je `f(g(x))`, a to je isto što i `pipe(g, f)(x)`. Kopija `[...fns]` ovde nije obavezna (`fns` je svež niz), ali je dobra navika: `reverse()` menja niz nad kojim se poziva, pa kopija ne dira originalni `fns`.
text.en: `compose` is `pipe` with the reverse order: `compose(f, g)(x)` is `f(g(x))`, which is the same as `pipe(g, f)(x)`. The copy `[...fns]` is not required here (`fns` is a fresh array), but it is a good habit: `reverse()` changes the array it is called on, so the copy leaves the original `fns` alone.

note.sr: `compose` ne ponavlja logiku: samo okreće redosled i koristi `pipe`.
note.en: `compose` does not repeat the logic: it only reverses the order and uses `pipe`.

text.sr: Isti početak kao ranije: skupljanje funkcija i argumenata, i poseban slučaj bez funkcija.
text.en: The same start as before: collecting the functions and the arguments, and the special case with no functions.

text.sr: Prva funkcija dobija sve argumente. Njen rezultat je tekuća vrednost `result`.
text.en: The first function receives all the arguments. Its result is the current value `result`.

text.sr: Petlja kreće od indeksa 1 (nulta funkcija je već primenjena) i svaku sledeću primenjuje na `result`. Na kraju vraćamo poslednju vrednost.
text.en: The loop starts at index 1 (function 0 has already been applied) and applies each following function to `result`. At the end we return the last value.
The returned function and `pipe` are closed.

text.sr: `compose` ima istu strukturu, ali kreće od kraja niza.
text.en: `compose` has the same structure but starts from the end of the array.

text.sr: Poslednja funkcija dobija sve argumente. Indeks `fns.length - 1` je poslednji element niza.
text.en: The last function receives all the arguments. The index `fns.length - 1` is the last element of the array.

text.sr:
Petlja ide unazad: počinje od predposlednje funkcije (`fns.length - 2`), smanjuje `i` do 0 uključujući i primenjuje svaku na `result`.

```
compose(add1, double)(3):
result = double(3) = 6   (poslednja)
i = 0: result = add1(6) = 7
```
text.en:
The loop goes backwards: it starts at the second-to-last function (`fns.length - 2`), decreases `i` down to 0 inclusive and applies each to `result`.

```
compose(add1, double)(3):
result = double(3) = 6   (the last one)
i = 0: result = add1(6) = 7
```

text.sr: Vraćamo rezultat i zatvaramo vraćenu funkciju i `compose`.
text.en: We return the result and close the returned function and `compose`.

note.sr: Duži kod, ali svaki korak je vidljiv. Ne menja ulazni niz, pa nema potrebe za kopijom.
note.en: Longer code, but every step is visible. It does not change the input array, so no copy is needed.
